formulas.actual: C = 6 * N * D, D = padded sequence positions processed (docs x 128 x epochs)
formulas.projection: N_10x = 10 N; D_10x = 20 N_10x; C_10x = 6 N_10x D_10x; multiple = C_10x / C_opt
formulas.N: non-embedding parameters; total parameters are context only

rows.Notes: Actual D = padded positions (10,752,000); actual D is 1.01x the compute-optimal D (counts 8 repeated epochs).
Same N and same training workload as the baseline, so identical 6ND values. 6ND does not capture linear attention's different attention cost.

rows.Configuration: Mixed-precision INT8 baseline (INT8 hidden layers + FP32 head)
rows.Notes: Post-training INT8 quantization of the trained FP32 baseline: training compute is the baseline's own (not reduced by INT8 storage). Quantization changes the inference representation, not the original training compute. Projection rows refer to the underlying baseline architecture.
Student's own 6ND only. Excludes teacher inference for soft targets and the cost of training the teacher first (see the baseline row). Actual D is 7.97x its compute-optimal D.

limitations: The 10x figures are formula-based projections, not measured training runs.
GPU utilization can change as model size increases.
Larger matrix multiplications may use the hardware more efficiently, so FLOPs would not translate linearly into wall-clock time.
A 10x larger model may exceed single-GPU memory.
Gradient checkpointing or smaller batches may be required, and those changes could alter wall-clock time.
Longer context lengths would change attention cost, which 6ND does not model.
Multi-GPU execution would introduce communication overhead.
The Chinchilla-style 20-tokens-per-parameter relationship is a rule of thumb, not a guarantee for this synthetic classification workload.
INT8 inference storage does not reduce the historical FP32 training cost.
Distillation has additional teacher-inference cost that the student's basic 6ND estimate does not capture.
Actual D counts 8 repeated epochs over the same documents; it is not a count of unique tokens.
Scaling-law figures are not used to rank the models.
generation_note: Computed in a sandbox by running the notebook's Part 6 cell on inputs built from the exact values printed in the executed Colab notebooks (parameter counts, 10,500 training documents, 457,666 non-padding tokens per epoch, 8 epochs, sequence length 128, class counts).
